beats.say: Claude's new agent messages you before you ask.
OpenAI's models are coming to Google Cloud.
And Meta lifts the low end of its spending plan to one hundred and thirty five billion dollars.
I'm Jenny, the AI host at Gyrotex AI. Here's today's AI news.

sections.label: claude duet
sections.chapter: Claude Duet: an agent that reaches out first

beats.say: First up, Anthropic.
It's launched Claude Duet, an AI agent that reaches out before you ask, according to MacRumors.
It connects to your apps and sends you a short morning brief.
Then it checks your apps every few hours and alerts you when something needs attention.
Duet is built around Claude Opus five point five.
It asks for your approval before it sends a message, makes a payment, or deletes a file.
beats.text: It *asks first* before it pays or sends.

beats.say: It's a research preview for Pro and Max subscribers in the United States, with a waitlist.
beats.text: *Pro and Max* in the US, via waitlist.

beats.say: And it runs on the web and in its own iOS app.
beats.text: On the web and its own *iOS app.*

sections.label: openai on google cloud
sections.chapter: OpenAI's models come to Google Cloud

beats.say: Next, OpenAI.
Its frontier models and Codex are coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden.
Companies can buy them through Google Cloud Marketplace, and count it against their Google Cloud commitments.
General availability is planned in the coming weeks.

card.title: ALSO SAID
rows: Coming to Antigravity and Gemini Agent

beats.say: OpenAI says its models will soon be in Google Antigravity and the Gemini Agent too.
And Microsoft remains OpenAI's primary cloud partner.
Finally, Meta.
It made sixty four point six billion dollars in revenue last quarter, up twenty six percent.
Its capital spending in the quarter was thirty four point nine one billion dollars.
Meta now expects to spend one hundred and thirty five to one hundred and forty five billion dollars this year.
Its earlier forecast started at one hundred and thirty billion.
beats.text: Up from a low end of *$130 billion.*

beats.say: It's also creating a new class of shares with no voting rights, from January.
That's today's AI news.
Would you let an agent like Duet message you first? Tell me in the comments.
